title: Decision Junction
prompt: Use case: UI mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for the mobile-first Nudge training web app. Primary request: design composition option 3, "Decision Junction," using the committed international-airport-wayfinding visual world. Render a straight-on 390x844 portrait app viewport with no device bezel, no hands, and no surrounding scene. This is a real designed app surface, not a poster or airport scene. Structure in order: a compact signal-white shared shell with black Nudge wordmark, a yellow phase tag "Performance," and quiet Catalog exit; directly beneath, a single horizontal black route band where Plan, Performance, Cooldown, and Review appear as strict decision points and the current point is marked by shape plus yellow; the central working area is a two-zone junction. Left/upper zone is a white current-work panel with "Dumbbell bench press," "Set 2 of 3," editable 95 lb and 8 reps, and a large black pictogram inset. Right/lower dominant zone is a monumental yellow directional sign reading "Start set" with a huge edge-locked arrow. Beneath the junction, a compact black information band shows concurrent "Bench rest 1:12" and a white next-decision strip says "Shoulder press is ready" with two equal agency controls "Go next" and "Stay here." At the bottom, a narrow overview gives 4 exercises / 11 sets / 45 min plan plus quiet "Finish workout". The current decision must be understood in one glance while the user can reject it. Style: airport yellow #FFCC00, jet black #0D0D0D, signal white, graphite and concrete neutrals; humanist sans similar to Frutiger, huge directional typography, strict edge arrows, squared enamel panels, black pictogram tiles, precise rules, high contrast, large touch targets. No rounded-card dashboard, no gradients, no glow, no glass, no photography, no planes, no airport labels, no new navigation model, no trophy or flag imagery, no streaks, praise, readiness score, scientific claims, urgency, guilt, coaching voice, or invented recommendation. Keep controls standard, focus visible, and phase/state understandable without color. Synthetic workout content only. No watermark.
